title: D-091 TW5: Linux commissioning checklist and certified start (owner-typed steps; orchestrator verification)
objective: Write the owner's Linux commissioning checklist (root-owned config file, Codex sign-in, systemd unit install, supervised certified start of lane 1 as a canary) and the orchestrator's verification after each step, then verify the owner's steps and record the lane-1 canary evidence. Every root, sign-in and start step is owner-typed. Enabling the combiner needs the owner's model choice (D-091-R008).
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
forbidden_paths: running any owner-typed step (root config, codex login, systemd install, start approval)
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: the checklist names each owner-typed step in plain words with the exact command and what the orchestrator verifies after it

after the owner's steps: the config verdict is PROTECTED, codex reports its admitted version, the unit parses, and the lane-1 canary shows one clean cycle under the 70% memory ceiling with the review cap honored
until the owner chooses the combining model, the combiner stays off and the loop runs with the Codex reviewer only
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
